Bill.BriefDescription: Managing costs of the ferry system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to managing costs of the ferry system; and creatinga new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature toaddress cost drivers and revenue projections that impact the ferrysystem. The legislature, therefore, intends to evaluate and developstrategies to manage costs and improve efficiencies of the ferrysystem.
